purpose: Resume an existing B02 run after reported Wave 1 CP1 acceptance; do not reset local state.
central_wiring_source: Resolve the actual ten-item list from the matching local RESUME and formal plan; its contents were not supplied remotely.

semantics.start_after: Required recovery or usable implementation handoff; this is not automatic product acceptance.
semantics.accept_after: Evidence required by original B02 acceptance remains mandatory.
semantics.partial_report: All ready work may finish with explicit dependency blockers, but missing mandatory evidence never becomes FEATURE_ACCEPTED.
semantics.formal_mapping: Reuse the accepted local C00 mapping; do not re-open it merely due to a new session and do not override real governance conflicts.

rules: The integration dimensions in RESTORE_AND_CP_A1 are not invented replacements for the local ten-item wiring list.
The reported test count is not an independently counted set of unique tests or integrated product acceptance.
C06, C07 and C08 write the scheduler serially; independent UI and verification tasks use their own files and temporary resources.
Original C00 and B02 requirements are not weakened by scheduling a checkpoint.
Only the coordinator changes shared types, generated files, refs or pushes.
A blocking provider permission does not stop unrelated authorized implementation, and a fixture never proves a real provider works.
No task reuses an old PASS for changed product bytes.
CP-A1 and intermediate commits are not the final user handoff unless an unavoidable owner-level blocker remains.
